config.title: AMA Integration
config.description: AMA SSO login condition. Login is allowed only when the registered entityId (AMA corporate ID) matches.

entityId.label: AMA entityId to allow
entityId.hint: The entityId (UUID) from your AMA corporate settings.

appCode.label: Custom app appCode (reference)
appCode.hint: The app name from the custom app registration (e.g. tpi-acm). Reference only — the login gate uses entityId.

scope.label: Expected scope
scope.hint: The scope of the Custom App token (e.g. custom_app:context). Compared during local verification.

secret.label: Custom App signing secret
secret.hint: The HS256 signing secret from the AMA Custom App registration. Stored encrypted and never shown again. Enter only to change it.
secret.placeholderSet: Set — enter a new value to change

categorySlug.label: Category slug
categorySlug.hint: The eccSlug claim in the Custom Category token (e.g. tpi-academy). Compared during local verification.

categorySecret.label: Custom Category signing secret
categorySecret.hint: HS256 signing secret of the AMA Custom Category (different from the Custom App). Stored encrypted and never shown again. Enter only to change.

deactivate.title: Block all logins?
deactivate.description: Deactivating rejects every AMA login that uses this config.

errors.required: Please enter both entityId and appCode.

category.title: Custom Category
category.description: Sign-in settings for the AMA Custom Category (/menu) entry. Uses a separate signing secret from the Custom App.

boda.title: BODA (보다에듀) Classroom Settings
boda.description: Credentials + ops options for the BODA SERVER API integration. Secrets (authKey, eventSecret) are AES-GCM encrypted and never returned again.
boda.secretHint: Paste the vendor-issued value. Masked after save — enter only when rotating.
boda.placeholderSet: Set — enter a new value to rotate
